segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Acquire open and dismiss actions from your SwiftUI environment. @Environment(\.openImmersiveSpace) var open @Environment(\.dismissImmersiveSpace) var dismiss let session: FoveatedStreamingSession // Present the immersive space when streaming begins (connect, resume), // and dismiss the immersive space when streaming ends (disconnect, pause). session.immersivePresentationBehaviors = .automatic(open, dismiss) // Present the immersive space on connect, and dismiss the immersive space on disconnect. // Do nothing on pause/resume. session.immersivePresentationBehaviors = [.presentOnConnect(open), .dismissOnDisconnect(dismiss)] // Disable all automatic presentation behaviors. // You must manually call `open` and `dismiss` to control presentation. session.immersivePresentationBehaviors = [] ```
